additional_requirements.title: Ensure all build steps are defined as code
additional_requirements.text: Convert pipeline instructions into code-based syntax and upload them to the organization's version control platform.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure steps have clearly defined build stage input and output
additional_requirements.text: For each build stage, clearly define what is expected for input and output.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure output is written to a separate, secured storage repository
additional_requirements.text: For each pipeline that produces output artifacts, write them to a secured storage repository.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure changes to pipeline files are tracked and reviewed
additional_requirements.text: For each pipeline file, track changes to it and review them.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure access to build process triggering is minimized
additional_requirements.text: For every pipeline in use, grant only the necessary users permission to trigger it.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure pipelines are automatically scanned for misconfigurations
additional_requirements.text: For each pipeline, set automated misconfiguration scanning.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure pipelines are automatically scanned for vulnerabilities
additional_requirements.text: For each pipeline, set automated vulnerability scanning.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure scanners are in place to identify and prevent sensitive data in pipeline files
additional_requirements.text: For every pipeline that is in use, set scanners that will identify and prevent sensitive data within it.
